senses.definition_en: tooth and nail

examples.english: The chaplin fought with them tooth and nail, unceasingly, three or four hours every morning.
examples.ref: 1886, Emilia Pardo Bazán, Los pazos de Ulloa:
examples.text: el capellán lidió con ellos a brazo partido, sin tregua, tres o cuatro horas todas las mañanas.
examples.translation: The chaplin fought with them tooth and nail, unceasingly, three or four hours every morning.

examples.english: Tacuabé was rolling around the grass tooth and nail with a blue-jacketed soldier
examples.ref: 1888, Eduardo Acevedo Díaz, Ismael, Buenos Aires: La Tribuna Nacional:
examples.text: Tacuabé rodaba por las yerbas a brazo partido con un soldado de casaca azul
examples.translation: Tacuabé was rolling around the grass tooth and nail with a blue-jacketed soldier

examples.english: Determined and brave, as on another solemn occasion, when in a struggle tooth and nail against the indomitable fury of the sea’s waves, he had managed to wrench from them the prey they fought to claim.
examples.ref: 1894, Alberto del Solar, Contra la marea:
examples.text: Resuelto, valeroso, como en otra ocasión solemne, cuando en lucha a brazo partido contra la furia indomable de las olas del mar, había logrado arrancarles la presa que ellas le disputaban
examples.translation: Determined and brave, as on another solemn occasion, when in a struggle tooth and nail against the indomitable fury of the sea’s waves, he had managed to wrench from them the prey they fought to claim.

examples.text: En tal sentido, la poesía contenida en este libro podría caracterizarse ante todo como una batalla a brazo partido con el carácter fatal de la propia condición poética

examples.english: So, it overflows with us, it tries to drown us, and only by fighting tooth and nail can we emerge, in some terrible occurances, from such an unequal battle.
examples.text: Entonces, se desborda con nosotros, nos intenta ahogar, y sólo luchando a brazo partido podemos salir en algunas ocasiones terribles de tan desigual batalla.
examples.translation: So, it overflows with us, it tries to drown us, and only by fighting tooth and nail can we emerge, in some terrible occurances, from such an unequal battle.
